name: example-agency-guide
title: guide page kind
description: A static one-destination guide page kind: a masthead naming the place, an opening chapter, a chapter list of two to six further chapters, optional practical facts (getting there, best time to visit, currency, language), optional places to see, an optional typographic gallery of place cards (pure CSS, no photographs), an optional plan-a-visit link to a single supplied URL, and a footer. Fits a city, region, trail or island told as chapters for a visitor deciding whether to go. Composed from nine vendored HyperUI blocks with Tailwind compiled once and inlined; no page kind JavaScript.

query.en: Use the guide family for a static one-destination guide mock: a masthead naming the place, an opening chapter, a chapter list of further chapters, and optional practical facts, places to see, a typographic gallery and a plan-a-visit link. Ask for the destination, its chapters, and any practical facts, places or a booking-free visit-planning URL, generate a schemaVersion 2 guide typed recipe through the bundled trusted compiler, and render it. This is a page kind, not a decoded client site: every fact in the reference fixture is a placeholder for a fictional destination. Not a recurring publication with a subscription, not a visited institution with programme and membership, not a directory of many independent listings, and not a travel-themed hero with no real place content.
